summary: Phase E of Partner API v1 (Merchant API, safe reward-events, conversions, bulk sync + async jobs, analytics, billing) is fully green — 52/52 pytest cases PASS end-to-end against the external URL. Verified: (Merchant) POST /merchant/businesses returns 201 with a mrc_ id, external_id de-dups (same external_id -> same merchant), Idempotency-Key replays the original response even when the body changes; GET single/list (cursor + external_id filter) and PATCH work; unknown merchant/offer -> 404 merchant_not_found/offer_not_found; POST offer with offer_type='not_a_type' -> 400 invalid_offer_type; offer external_id de-dup verified. (Reward Events) POST /reward-events returns created=true first time, status='recorded' + credited=false (NO wallet mutation, as designed); invalid type -> 400 invalid_reward_event_type; value_cents cap enforced at 1_000_000; external_id re-send returns created=false and the SAME event_id; Idempotency-Key replay returns the ORIGINAL response WITH created=true preserved; GET/list cursor + type filter work; unknown id -> 404. (Conversions) same shape: create/dedup/idem/list/get all correct; invalid conversion_type -> 400. (Bulk/Jobs) POST /bulk/conversions with 4 items (2 unique-ok, 1 external_id dup, 1 invalid type) returns 202 with a queued job; poll GET /jobs/{id} transitions queued->completed within ~1s; results array has statuses [ok, ok, duplicate, error] with per-row {index, status, id?/error?}; offers bulk without merchant_id -> per-row error='merchant_id_required'; invalid /bulk/{op} -> 400 invalid_bulk_operation. (Scope enforcement) Freshly-minted limited key (catalog:read + jobs:write + jobs:read + rewards:read only) -> POST /bulk/conversions returns 403 insufficient_scope with missing=['conversions:write']; POST /reward-events -> 403; POST /merchant/businesses -> 403. (Analytics) /analytics/summary?days=30 returns all required fields (campaigns/spend/impressions/clicks/ctr/conversions/conversion_value_cents/reward_events/reward_points/merchants/offers/cvr) with correct counts reflecting data created this run; /analytics/timeseries?metric=conversions works and returns {series, total}; invalid metric -> 400 invalid_metric. (Billing) /billing/summary returns balance_cents + lifetime_spend_cents + period_conversion_value_cents + advertisers + invoices + currency='usd' + current_period; /billing/invoices lists monthly statements (currency=usd, status in {open,final}, line_items array); /billing/invoices/{id} 200 for a real id, 404 invoice_not_found for a bogus one — the previously-reported naive/aware datetime bug is confirmed fixed via _aware(). (Cross-cutting) Every response — including 400/403/404 — stamps X-RadioLife-API-Version:1 + X-Request-ID; normalized error envelope {error:{code,message,field?,request_id}} present on every failure; /capabilities exposes feature_flags for merchant_api/reward_events/conversions/bulk_jobs/analytics/billing; /me lists all 10 new Phase-E scopes on the full-scope key. (Regression) Phase A discovery (/capabilities, /markets, /stations, /targeting/options, /rate-card, /status, /me, /products, /inventory) all 200; Phase B /quotes still 200; Phase C /creatives paginates; Phase D /game-templates, /predictions/eligible, /inventory/display, /inventory/audio all 200.

minor.issue: In-memory pagination cap — services fetch .limit(500|1000) then paginate via ext.paginate. Same pattern flagged in iter121/122/123 for /campaigns, /creatives, /sponsorships, /sponsored-games. A partner with >1000 reward-events/conversions or >500 jobs/invoices will silently truncate. Push cursoring into the underlying Mongo query.

list_invoices() calls _generate_invoices() on EVERY request which loops all campaigns + marketplace promotions and upserts monthly buckets. That's O(campaigns+promos) per read and rewrites 'final' months every time (only updated_at changes but the whole doc is $set). Consider caching + regenerating only current-month, or gate regen behind a materialization job.
Detail endpoint also calls _generate_invoices() before lookup — for a 404 (bad id) this still does the full regen. Move the regen behind a cheap existence check or a materialized-view.

action_items: (optional/consistency) Push cursor pagination into Mongo queries for /reward-events, /conversions, /jobs, /merchant/businesses, offers list, /billing/invoices — same recommendation carried from earlier phases.
(optional/perf) Avoid regenerating ALL monthly invoices on every /billing/invoices and /billing/invoices/{id} call. Cache 'final' months; only recompute the current 'open' month.

(optional/robustness) partner_api_phase_e.record_reward_event/record_conversion swallow ValueError('invalid_datetime') from _parse_dt(occurred_at) into a 400 at the route — but the partner_api_phase_e.create_offer path also parses starts_at/ends_at; a bad datetime there raises inside create_offer BEFORE it's caught, producing a 500 with detail 'invalid_datetime' rather than the normalized 400 envelope. Route should also convert ValueError from create_offer/patch_offer to 400.
critical_code_review_comments: services/partner_api_phase_e.py::run_job constructs a Caller with scopes=set() — that's fine because the safe single-record path here (record_reward_event/record_conversion/create_offer) never re-checks scopes, but it's fragile. If future code paths add an inner scope guard, bulk jobs will silently start failing. Consider passing the ORIGINAL caller's scopes forward, or make the intent explicit in a comment (already partial).

services/partner_api_phase_e.py::_generate_invoices — every non-current period is stored with status='final' but $set overwrites the doc every regen. That means updated_at bumps on every read even for months that will never change again, which pollutes any downstream 'invoice updated' observability. Split into upsert-if-new + refresh-open-only.

services/partner_api_phase_e.py::run_job — a single item failure is caught with `except Exception as e: results.append({'error': str(e)})`. That's fine, but leaks internal error text (e.g. Mongo errors) verbatim to the partner. Consider mapping ValueError -> its code and defaulting the rest to a generic 'internal_error'.
services/partner_api_phase_e.py::create_offer accepts starts_at/ends_at but does NOT validate that ends_at > starts_at. Silent no-op in the current schema; would be worth a 400 for a bad range.

routes/partner_api_v1.py::create_bulk_job_ep — Idempotency-Key cache is written AFTER `_aio.create_task(pe.run_job(...))` is scheduled, so a very-fast client retry with the same idem key before the cache write could double-queue the SAME job. Move idem_save BEFORE create_task, or make idem_save idempotent-on-conflict.

routes/partner_api_v1.py::create_reward_event_ep + create_conversion_ep — Idempotency-Key cache stores the FIRST full response including `created:true`. If that first request actually hit an external_id dup path and returned created=false, the idem cache would still say created=false forever for that idem key — which is correct. Confirmed via test_4_idempotency_key_replays_created.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase E is green end-to-end and can be safely built on for Phase F. All 6 new Phase E collections (partner_merchants, partner_offers, partner_reward_events, partner_conversions, partner_jobs, partner_invoices) are keyed by (partner_id, environment) so LIVE/SANDBOX never collide — confirmed by test_me_has_phase_e_scopes + all writes going through sandbox. Idempotency-Key + external_id use the shared services/partner_api_ext.py helpers (idem_get/idem_save + external_get/external_save), same as A-D. Reward events are RECORDED-ONLY (credited:false, status='recorded') — main agent should preserve that invariant when wiring the real listener-wallet consumer feature later. Bulk jobs run inline via asyncio.create_task in the same process; there's no external worker/queue — under load this may need Celery/RQ. The billing invoice generation runs on EVERY /billing/invoices call (perf note in minor issues). If Phase F adds partner webhooks or partner payouts, extend test_iter124 with webhook signing + payout endpoint assertions.
